titles.title: Mule Skull with Turkey Feather

description: A foreshortened view of a mule's skull dominates the composition. To the left of the skull is a black and white striped turkey feather. The objects sit on a plain white background of exposed paper.
imageCaption: Courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago.
title: Untitled (Skull with Turkey Feather)
